🎤 **BECOME A POP STAR!** 🌟

Ever dreamed of becoming a world-famous singer? 💗 Start with nothing and rise to the top of the music industry!

🎶 Write and release your own hit songs!
📈 Climb the charts and earn millions of streams!
🎤 Perform concerts, sell tickets and become a superstar!
💿 Create albums and build your discography!
🌎 Choose your music genre — Pop, K-pop, Indie, Rock, Country, Latin & more!
💖 Collect Charms and unlock powerful boosts!
✨ Upgrade your studio, microphones and career!
🏆 Rebirth, earn Legacy Stars and build your music empire!
👑 Compete with other artists and become a music legend!

🎁 NEW CODES:
🌟 1MILLION — $100K + 2,500 Fans
🎤 SHOWTIME — $25K + 500 Fans (LIMITED!)

🍓 Made with love by Starberry Studios!

⭐ Like & favourite for more updates!

Your music. Your career. Your spotlight. 💗
